name: package-reputation-scan-fixture
description: Manifest-only package reputation testing fixture. Scan this file; do not install or execute its dependencies.

reputationTestNotes.usage: Commit this package.json to an isolated scanner test repository or scan it directly. Do not run npm install, npm ci, or import these packages. This fixture contains package references only; no package payloads have been downloaded.
reputationTestNotes.expectations: These are historically documented reputation risks, not guaranteed scanner findings. Labels, severity, and coverage depend on the scanner's data source and policy. Some releases have been removed from registries. Scanners requiring registry resolution or a lockfile may not process this manifest alone. Some incidents also have security advisories and may appear under SCA rather than Package Reputation.
reputationTestNotes.metadata: reputationTestNotes and reputationTestCases are explanatory custom fields; they do not force scanner results. Every test package is listed as a direct dependency, including flatmap-stream, which was historically introduced transitively through event-stream.

reputationTestCases.reason: A compromised publisher account released malicious versions of a legitimate package.
A legitimate npm package was hijacked to distribute credential-stealing malware.
This release is listed in the embedded-malware advisory for the rc account takeover.

reputationTestCases.category: Supply chain compromise through a malicious dependency
reputationTestCases.reason: A malicious actor added flatmap-stream to this legitimate package's dependency tree.
